|------|---------|

```
=== Loaded Modules (coding zenka) ===

  [2] p7c_runtime       v2.4.1    /opt/zenka/lib/p7c_runtime.so
  [3] p7c_crypto        v2.4.1    /opt/zenka/lib/p7c_crypto.so
  [4] p7c_network       v2.4.1    /opt/zenka/lib/p7c_network.so

```
